events.description: Most DJs learn what works by standing behind the decks. T-Puse went and studied the science of why. Omer Gani came out of Tel Aviv, spent years on psychoacoustics and what sound actually does to people, and brought it back to the floor. He runs his own label, URSUL, releases on Maccabi House, and put out his debut album, Camelboy, in 2024.
